**Finding submitted — AUDIT: needs_review (fallback target).**

- **Only responsive clause binding us:** Section 9.9 (p0415–p0419), which is mutual. Section 6.9 gives *Sanofi* audit rights over RevMed, so it benefits our party and was not flagged.
- **Already satisfactory in structure:** independent auditor of international prominence reasonably acceptable to the audited Party; auditor and auditing Party bound by confidentiality (Article XI plus a separate auditor NDA); scope limited to books and records under Section 9.8, so no direct systems access; auditing Party bears full cost absent underpayment.
- **The gap:** frequency, notice period and the underpayment cost-shifting threshold are all redacted `[***]`, so the fallback floors cannot be verified.
- **Proposed cure (validated, ok:true, minimality passed):** three surgical replacements setting one audit per Calendar Year, fifteen (15) days' prior notice, and a ten percent (10%) underpayment threshold — mutual, with all surrounding language (including the customary "for cause" carve-out and the look-back limit) untouched.
